notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing: 12430 S. 700 East Zoning Map Amendment and Development Agreement Requests
notices.agenda_text:
Posted on November 5, 2026 on the Utah Public Notice Website www.utah.gov/pmn/ Draper City Website www.draperutah.gov/news/ and at Draper City Hall, 1020 E. Pioneer Road, Draper, UT

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: 12430 S. 700 East Zoning Map Amendment and Development Agreement Requests

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the City Council to consider the above listed requests.  The property is located at approximately 12430 S. 700 East.  The purpose of the request is for a: 1) rezone from RA1 (Residential Agricultural, 40,000 sq. ft. minimum) and RA2 (Residential Agricultural, 20,000 sq. ft. minimum) to R4 (Single Family Residential, 10,000 sq. ft. minimum), and 2) development agreement to allow the property to develop with specific setback, landscaping and fencing standards in conjunction with a rezoning application.

The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers on November 17, 2026, at 7:00 p.m.  The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall. 

To request a copy of the public notice or for additional inquiries contact Maryann DeHaven at (801) 576-6391 or maryann.dehaven@draperutah.gov.

Dated this 5th Day of November, 2026

Attest: Nicole Smedley, City Recorder

Posted on October 29, 2026, on the Utah Public Notice Website www.utah.gov/pmn/ Draper City Website www.draperutah.gov/news/ and at Draper City Hall, 1020 E. Pioneer Road, Draper, UT

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: The Duffin Land Use Map And Zoning Map Amendment Request

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the City Council to consider the above listed request. The property is located at approximately 267 W. 11915 S. The purpose of the request is to Change the current zoning designation from R3 (Single-family residential) to CBP (Business/manufacturing park) and change the existing land use designation from Residential Medium Density to Business & Light Manufacturing.

The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers, on November 10, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall. 
.
